name: NGC 4806, SN 2011fh field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4806, a spiral galaxy that hosted SN 2011fh, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2011fh-hubble
story: In one of the spiral arms of NGC 4806, a young and massive star gave rise to SN 2011fh, a luminous outburst much like the puzzling SN 2009ip. When Hubble checked the site years later, a bright source was still shining there.

claims.text: SN 2011fh is in one of the spiral arms of the spiral galaxy NGC 4806
A young and massive star gave rise to a luminous SN 2009ip-like event
SN 2011fh was classified as a Type IIn supernova
Hubble observations in 2016 (program 14149) still found a bright source at the site
